(outside all of the above) are treated as\n323\t/// statement terminators.\n324\tfn split_sql_statements(sql: &str) -> Vec<&str> {\n325\t    let bytes = sql.as_bytes();\n326\t    let len = {\n355\t                i += 1;\n356\t            }\n357\t            continue;\n358\t        }\n359\t\n360\t        // --- Single-quoted string state ---\n361\t        if in_single_quote {\n362\t            if b == b'\\'' {\n363\t                // '' is an escaped quote inside a string literal\n364\t                if i + 1 < len && bytes[i + 1] == b'\\'' {\n365\t                    i += 2;\n366\t                } else {\n367\t                    in_single_quote = false;\n368\t                    i += 1;\n369\t                }\n370\t            } else {\n371\t                i += 1;\n372\t            }\n373\t            continue;\n374\t        }\n375\t\n376\t        // --- Double-quoted identifier state ---\n377\t        if in_double_quote {\n378\t            if b == b'\"'        i += 1;\n384\t                }\n385\t            } else {\n386\t                i += 1;\n387\t            }\n388\t            continue;\n389\t        }\n390\t\n391\t        // --- Top-level identifiers, and comments.\n///\n/// A naive `split(';')` breaks when SQL string literals contain semicolons\n/// (e.g., `INSERT INTO t(v) VALUES('a;b')`). This function uses a small state\n/// machine to track whether the current position is inside:\n/// - A single-quoted string literal (`'...'`, with `''` as escape)\n/// - A double-quoted identifier (`\"...\"`, with `\"\"` as escape)\n/// - A line comment (`-- ...`)\n/// - A block comment (`/* ... */`)\n///\n/// Only semicolons at the top level (outside all of the above) are treated as\n/// statement terminators.\nfn split_sql_statements(sql: &str) -> Vec<&str> {\n    let bytes = sql.as_bytes();\n    let len = bytes.len();\n    let mut stmts = Vec::new();\n    let mut start = 0; // byte offset where the current statement begins\n    let mut i = 0;\n\n    // State flags — at most one is true at a time.\n    let mut in_single_quote = false;\n    let mut in_double_quote = false;\n    let mut in_line_comment = false;\n    let mut in_block_comment = false;\n\n    while i < len {\n        let b = bytes[i];\n\n        // --- Line comment state ---\n        if in_line_comment {\n            if b == b'\\n' {\n                in_line_comment = false;\n            }\n            i += 1;\n            continue;\n        }\n\n        // --- Block comment state ---\n        if in_block_comment {\n            if b == b'*' && i + 1 < len && bytes[i + 1] == b'/' {\n                in_block_comment = false;\n                i += 2;\n            } else {\n                i += 1;\n            }\n            continue;\n        }\n\n        // --- Single-quoted string state ---\n        if in_single_quote {\n            if b == b'\\'' {\n                // '' is an escaped quote inside a string literal\n                if i + 1 < len && bytes[i + 1] == b'\\'' {\n                    i += 2;\n                } else {\n                    in_single_quote = false;\n                    i += 1;\n                }\n            } else {\n                i += 1;\n            }\n            continue;\n        }\n\n        // --- Double-quoted identifier state ---\n        if in_double_quote {\n            if b == b'\"' {\n                if i + 1 < len && bytes[i + 1] == b'\"' {\n                    i += 2;\n                } else {\n                    in_double_quote = false;\n                    i += 1;\n                }\n            } else {\n                i += 1;\n            }\n            continue;\n        }\n\n        // --- Top-level parsing ---\n        if b == b'\\'' {\n            in_single_quote = true;\n            i += 1;\n        } else if b == b'\"' {\n            in_double_quote = true;\n            i += 1;\n        } else if b == b'-' && i + 1 < len && bytes[i + 1] == b'-' {\n            in_line_comment = true;\n            i += 2;\n        } else if b == b'/' && i + 1 < len && bytes[i + 1] == b'*' {\n            in_block_comment = true;\n            i += 2;\n        } else if b == b';' {\n            // Statement terminator at top level.\n            let stmt = &sql[start..i];\n            if !stmt.trim().is_empty() {\n                stmts.push(stmt.trim());\n            }\n            start = i + 1;\n            i += 1;\n        } else {\n            i += 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Trailing statement without a final semicolon.\n    if start < len {\n        let stmt = &sql[start..len];\n        if !stmt.trim().is_empty() {\n            stmts.push(stmt.trim());\n        }\n    }\n\n    stmts\n}\n\n/// Execute multiple SQL statements separated by semicolons.\nfn execute_batch(conn: &Connection, sql: &str) -> anyhow::Result<()> {\n    conn.execute_batch(sql)?;\n    Ok(())\n}\n\npub fn apply_schema(conn: &Connection) -> anyhow::Result<()> {\n    execute_batch(conn, SCHEMA_SQL)?;\n    apply_migrations(conn)?;\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// Apply database migrations for schema changes.\n/// This handles adding new columns to existing tables.\nfn apply_migrations(conn: &Connection) -> anyhow::Result<()> {\n    // Migration 1: Update critical_path_cache schema if it has the old format\n    // Old format: bead_id, float (REAL), updated_at\n    // New format: bead_id, epic_id, es (INTEGER), ls (INTEGER), float (INTEGER), updated_at\n    let has_es: bool = conn\n        .query_row(\n            \"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pragma_table_info('critical_path_cache') WHERE name='es'\",\n            [],\n            |row| row.get::<_, i64>(0).map(|n| n > 0),\n        )\n        .unwrap_or(false);\n\n    if !has_es {\n        // Table has old schema - recreate with new schema\n        conn.execute_batch(\n            \"BEGIN;\n             CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS critical_path_cache_new (\n                 bead_id     TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n                 epic_id     TEXT,\n                 es          INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,\n                 ls          INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,\n                 float       INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,\n                 updated_at  DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n                 FOREIGN KEY (bead_id) REFERENCES issues(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\n             );\n             INSERT INTO critical_path_cache_new (bead_id, float, updated_at)\n                 SELECT bead_id, CAST(float AS INTEGER), updated_at FROM critical_path_cache;\n             DROP TABLE critical_path_cache;\n             ALTER TABLE critical_path_cache_new RENAME TO critical_path_cache;\n             COMMIT;\",\n        )?;\n    }\n\n    // Create indexes for critical_path_cache (idempotent)\n    let _ = conn.execute_batch(\n        \"CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_critical_path_cache_epic ON critical_path_cache(epic_id);\n         CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_critical_path_cache_float ON critical_path_cache(float);\",\n    );\n\n    // Migration 2: Add workspace_path to worker_sessions if missing\n    // Older databases may not have this column; or volatile audit fields that would otherwise make\n    /// semantically identical issues look different across import/export\n    /// boundaries, while still comparing the full synced payload including\n    /// labels, dependencies, comments, and user-visible timestamps like `due_at`.\n    #[must_use]\n    pub fn sync_equals(&self, other: &Self) -> bool {\n        if self.id != other.id\n            || self.title != other.title\n            || self.description != other.description\n            || self.design != other.design\n            || self.acceptance_criteria != other.deleted_by\n            || self.delete_reason != other.delete_reason\n            || self.original_type != other.original_type\n            || self.compacted_at != other.compacted_at\n            || self.compacted_at_commit != other.compacted_at_commit\n            || self.original_size != other.original_size\n            || self.sender != other.sender\n            || self.ephemeral != other.ephemeral\n            || self.pinned != other.pinned\n            || self.is_template != other.is_template\n        {\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        // Handle compaction_level serialization quirk where None == 0\n        if self.compaction_level.unwrap_or(0) != other.compaction_level.unwrap_or(0) {\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        // Fast path for relations: if lengths differ, they can't be equal\n        if self.dependencies.len() != other.dependencies.len()\n            || self.comments.len() != other.comments.len()\n        {\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        // Compare labels (order independent)\n        let mut self_labels = self.labels.clone();\n        self_labels.sort_unstable();\n        self_labels.dedup();\n        let mut other_labels = other.labels.clone();\n        other_labels.sort_unstable();\n        other_labels.dedup();\n        if self_labels != other_labels {\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        // Compare dependencies (order independent)\n        let mut self_deps = self.dependencies.clone();\n        self_deps.sort_by(|left, right| {\n            left.issue_id\n                .cmp(&right.issue_id)\n                .then_with(|| left.depends_on_id.cmp(&right.depends_on_id))\n                .then_with(|| left.dep_type.as_str().cmp(right.dep_type.as_str()))\n                .then_with(|| left.created_at.cmp(&right.created_at))\n                .then_with(|| left.created_by.cmp(&right.created_by))\n                .then_with(|| left.metadata.cmp(&right.metadata))\n                .then_with(|| left.thread_id.cmp(&right.thread_id))\n        });\n        let mut other_deps = other.dependencies.clone();\n        other_deps.sort_by(|left, right| {\n            left.issue_id\n                .cmp(&right.issue_id)\n                .then_with(|| left.depends_on_id.cmp(&right.depends_on_id))\n                .then_with(|| left.dep_type.as_str().cmp(right.dep_type.as_str()))\n                .then_with(|| left.created_at.cmp(&right.created_at))\n                .then_with(|| left.created_by.cmp(&right.created_by))\n                .then_with(|| left.metadata.cmp(&right.metadata))\n                .then_with(|| left.thread_id.cmp(&right.thread_id))\n        });\n        if self_deps != other_deps {\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        // Compare comments (order independent)\n        let mut self_comments = self.comments.clone();\n        self_comments.sort_by(|left, right| {\n            left.issue_id\n                .cmp(&right.issue_id)\n                .then_with(|| left.created_at.cmp(&right.created_at))\n                .then_with(|| left.author.cmp(&right.author))\n                .then_with(|| left.body.cmp(&right.body))\n                .then_with(|| left.id.cmp(&right.id))\n        });\n        let mut other_comments = other.comments.clone();\n        other_comments.sort_by(|left, right| {\n            left.issue_id\n                .cmp(&right.issue_id)\n                .then_with(|| left.created_at.cmp(&right.created_at))\n                .then_with(|| left.author.cmp(&right.author))\n                .then_with(|| left.body.cmp(&right.body))\n                .then_with(|| left.id.cmp(&right.id))\n        });\n        if self_comments != other_comments {\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        true\n    }\n\n    /// Check if this issue is a tombstone that has exceeded its TTL.\n    #[must_use]\n    pub fn is_expired_tombstone(&self, retention_days: Option<u64>) -> bool {\n        if self.status != Status::Tombstone {\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        let Some(days) = retention_days else {\n            return false;\n        };\n\n        if days == 0 {\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        let Some(deleted_at) = self.deleted_at else {\n            return false;\n        };\n\n        // Clamp days to a safe maximum to avoid panic in Duration::days().\n        let max_safe_days = 365_u64 * 1000;\n        let days_i64 = i64::try_from(days.min(max_safe_days)).unwrap_or(365_000);\n        let expiration_time = deleted_at + chrono::Duration::days(days_i64);\n        Utc::now() > expiration_time\n    }\n}\n\n/// Epic Ok(())\n893\t}\n894\t\n895\tfn cmd_create(\n896\t    beads_dir: &PathBuf,\n897\t    title: String,\n898\t    type_: String,\n899\t    priority: i32,\n900\t    description: Option<String>,\n901\t dry_run: bool,\n\n        /// Skip verification steps\n        #[arg(long)]\n        skip_verify: bool,\n    },\n}\n\n#[derive(Subcommand)]\npub enum DepCommands {\n    /// Add a dependency\n    Add },\n}\n\n#[derive(Subcommand)]\npub enum LabelCommands {\n    /// Add label(s) to an issue\n    Add {\n        /// Label(s) to add (multiple labels supported)\n        #[arg(short, long, required =  assignee: Option<String>,\n    labels: Vec<String>,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    let config = load_config(beads_dir)?;\n    let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = Option<String>,\n    priority: Option<i32>,\n    limit: Option<usize>,\n    all: bool,\n    format: &str,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n    let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n\n    let mut issues = if all {\n        // Include archived beads\n        list_all_with_archives(beads_dir)?\n    } Some(Status::from_str(s.as_str()).map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?);\n        }\n        if let Some(ref t) = type_ {\n            filter.issue_type =\n                Some(IssueType::from_str(t.as_str()).map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?);\n        }\n        filter.assignee = assignee.clone();\n        filter.priority = priority;\n        // --limit 0 means unlimited\n        filter.limit = limit.and_then(|l| if l == 0 { None } else { Some(l) });\n        storage.list_issues(&filter)?\n    };\n\n    // Apply additional filters for --all mode (since we're not using DB filters)\n    if all {\n        if let Some(ref s) = status {\n            let status_filter = Status::from_str(s.as_str()).map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?;\n            issues.retain(|i| i.status == status_filter);\n        }\n        if let Some(ref t) = type_ {\n            let type_filter = IssueType::from_str(t.as_str()).map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?;\n            issues.retain(|i| i.issue_type == type_filter);\n        }\n        if let Some(ref assignee_val) = assignee {\n            issues.retain(|i| i.assignee.as_deref() == Some(assignee_val));\n        }\n        if let Some(p) = priority {\n            issues.retain(|i| i.priority.0 == p);\n        }\n        // Apply limit\n        if let Some(l) = limit {\n            if l != 0 {\n                issues.truncate(l);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    let output_format = OutputFormat::from_str(format).unwrap_or(OutputFormat::Text);\n    let formatter = get_formatter(output_format);\n    print!(\"{}\", formatter.format_issues(&issues));\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_show(beads_dir: &PathBuf, id: &str, format: &str) -> Result<()> {\n    let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n    let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n\n    let issue = match storage.get_issue(id)? {\n        Some(i) => i,\n        None => {\n            // serde_json::to_string(&vec![out])?);\n        }\n        \"toon\" => {\n            println!(\"ID: {}\", issue.id);\n            println!(\"Title: {}\", issue.title);\n            println!(\"Status: {}\", issue.status);\n            println!(\"Priority: {}\", issue.priority);\n            println!(\"Type: {}\", issue.issue_type);\n            if let Some(desc) = &issue.description {\n                println!(\"Description: {}\", desc);\n            }\n            if let Some(assignee) = &issue.assignee {\n                println!(\"Assignee: {}\", assignee);\n            }\n            if !issue.labels.is_empty() {\n                println!(\"Labels: {}\", issue.labels.join(\", \"));\n            }\n        }\n        _ => {\n            println!(\"ID: {}\", issue.id);\n            println!(\"Title: {}\", issue.title);\n            println!(\"Status: {}\", issue.status);\n            println!(\"Priority: {}\", issue.priority);\n            println!(\"Type: {}\", issue.issue_type);\n            if let Some(desc) = &issue.description {\n                println!(\"Description: {}\", desc);\n            }\n            if let Some(assignee) = &issue.assignee {\n                println!(\"Assignee: {}\", assignee);\n            }\n            if !issue.labels.is_empty() {\n                println!(\"Labels: {}\", issue.labels.join(\", \"));\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_update(\n    beads_dir: &PathBuf,\n    id: &str,\n    title: Option<String>,\n    status: Option<String>,\n    priority: Option<i32>,\n    assignee: cmd_ready(beads_dir: &PathBuf, limit: usize, format: &str) -> Result<()> {\n    let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n    let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n\n    let candidates = storage.with_immediate_transaction(|tx| get_ready_candidates(tx, limit))?;\n\n    match format {\n        \"json\" => {\n            for candidate in candidates {\n                println!(\"{}\", serde_json::to_string(&candidate)?);\n            }\n        }\n        \"toon\" => {\n            for candidate in candidates {\n                println!(\n                    \"{}\",\n                    crate::format::toon::format_ready_bead(\n                        &candidate.id,\n                        &candidate.title,\n                        candidate.priority,\n                        candidate.downstream_impact,\n                        candidate.critical_float,\n                    )\n                );\n            }\n        }\n        _ => {\n            for candidate in candidates {\n                println!(\n                    \"[{}] {} (priority={}, impact={}, float={})\",\n                    candidate.id,\n                    candidate.title,\n                    candidate.priority,\n                    candidate.downstream_impact,\n                    candidate.critical_float\n                );\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_claim(\n    beads_dir: &PathBuf,\n    assignee: &str,\n    model: Option<String>,\n    harness: Option<String>,\n    harness_version: Option<String>,\n    any: bool,\n    fallback: Option<&str>,\n    workspace_paths: &[PathBuf],\n    dry_run: bool,\n    format: &str,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    let config = load_config(beads_dir)?;\n    let claim_ttl = config.claim_ttl_minutes;\n\n    // Build worker metadata\n    let worker_metadata = WorkerMetadata {\n        worker_id: assignee.to_string(),\n        model: model.clone(),\n        harness: harness.clone(),\n        harness_version: harness_version.clone(),\n    };\n\n    if dry_run {\n        // Dry run mode - show what would be claimed\n        let candidates: Vec<(PathBuf, crate::claim::ScoredBead)> = if any || fallback == Some(\"any\")\n        {\n            // Multi-workspace dry run\n            let paths = if workspace_paths.is_empty() {\n                // Auto-discover workspaces from current directory\n                find_workspaces(&std::env::current_dir()?)?\n            } else {\n                workspace_paths.to_vec()\n            };\n\n            let mut all_candidates = Vec::new();\n            for path in &paths {\n                let local_beads_dir = path.join(\".beads\");\n                if local_beads_dir.exists() {\n                    let local_metadata = match load_metadata(&local_beads_dir) {\n                        Ok(m) => m,\n                        Err(_) => continue,\n                    };\n                    let local_db_path = local_beads_dir.join(&local_metadata.database);\n                    if let Ok(local_storage) = Storage::open(&local_db_path) {\n                        if let Ok(local_candidates) = local_storage\n                            .with_immediate_transaction(|tx| get_ready_candidates(tx, 1))\n                        {\n                            for c in local_candidates {\n                                all_candidates.push((path.clone(), c));\n                            }\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n\n            // Sort by score and take top 1\n            all_candidates.sort_by(|a, b| {\n                let score_a = (b.1.downstream_impact, b.1.priority, b.1.created_at.clone());\n                let score_b = (a.1.downstream_impact, a.1.priority, a.1.created_at.clone());\n                score_a.cmp(&score_b)\n            });\n            all_candidates.into_iter().take(1).collect()\n        } else {\n            // Single workspace dry run\n            let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n            let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n            let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n            let candidates =\n                storage.with_immediate_transaction(|tx| get_ready_candidates(tx, 1))?;\n            candidates\n                .into_iter()\n                .map(|c| (beads_dir.parent().unwrap_or(beads_dir).to_path_buf(), c))\n                .collect()\n        };\n\n        if let Some((path, candidate)) = candidates.first() {\n            match format {\n                \"json\" => {\n                    let output = serde_json::json!({\n                        \"bead_id\": candidate.id,\n                        \"title\": candidate.title,\n                        \"priority\": candidate.priority,\n                        \"downstream_impact\": candidate.downstream_impact,\n                        \"assignee\": assignee,\n                        \"workspace\": path.display().to_string(),\n                        \"dry_run\": true\n                    });\n                    println!(\"{}\", output);\n                }\n                _ => {\n                    println!(\n                        \"{} (priority={}, impact={}, workspace={})\",\n                        candidate.id,\n                        candidate.priority,\n                        candidate.downstream_impact,\n                        path.display()\n                    );\n                }\n            }\n        } else if format == \"json\" {\n            println!(\"{{}}\");\n        } else {\n            println!(\"No beads available to claim\");\n        }\n    } else if any {\n        // Claim from any workspace\n        let paths = if workspace_paths.is_empty() {\n            // Auto-discover workspaces from current directory\n            find_workspaces(&std::env::current_dir()?)?\n        } else {\n            workspace_paths.to_vec()\n        };\n\n        let result = claim_any(&paths, assignee, claim_ttl, Some(&worker_metadata))?;\n\n        match result {\n            Some(ClaimResult {\n                bead_id,\n                reclaimed,\n                workspace_path,\n            }) => match format {\n                \"json\" => {\n                    let output = serde_json::json!({\n                        \"bead_id\": bead_id,\n                        \"reclaimed\": reclaimed,\n                        \"assignee\": assignee,\n                        \"workspace\": workspace_path.map(|p| p.display().to_string())\n                    });\n                    println!(\"{}\", output);\n                }\n                _ => {\n                    if let Some(path) = workspace_path {\n tree.\nfn print_dep_tree(nodes: &[crate::storage::DepTreeNode], _storage: &Storage) -> Result<()> {\n    if nodes.is_empty() {\n        println!(\"  (no dependencies)\");\n        return Ok(());\n    }\n\n    // Status indicators: ●=open, ◐=in_progress, ○=closed/blocked/deferred, ⊘=tombstone\n    let status_symbol = |status: &str| -> char {\n        match status {\n            \"open\" => '●',\n            \"in_progress\" => '◐',\n            \"closed\" => '○',\n            \"blocked\" => '◌',\n            \"deferred\" => '○',\n            \"tombstone\" => '⊘',\n            _ => '○',\n        }\n    };\n\n    for (i, node) in nodes.iter().enumerate() {\n        let is_cycle = node.path.contains(\"[CYCLE]\");\n\n        // Build tree prefix with proper branching\n        let mut prefix = String::new();\n        if node.depth > 0 {\n            for d in 0..node.depth as usize {\n                if d < node.depth as usize - 1 {\n                    prefix.push_str(\"│   \");\n                } else {\n                    // Check if this is the last node at this depth\n                    let is_last = nodes\n                        .iter()\n                        .skip(i + 1)\n                        .all(|n| n.depth < node.depth || (n.depth == node.depth && n.id > node.id));\n                    if is_last {\n                        prefix.push_str(\"└── \");\n                    } else {\n                        prefix.push_str(\"├── \");\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Truncate title if too long\n        let title = if node.title.len() > 60 {\n            format!(\"{}...\", &node.title[..57])\n        } else {\n            node.title.clone()\n        };\n\n        let cycle_mark = if is_cycle { \" [CYCLE]\" } else { \"\" };\n        let dep_type_str = node.dep_type.as_deref().unwrap_or(\"blocks\");\n\n        println!(\n            \"{}[{}] {} {} (P{}, {}){}\",\n            prefix,\n            node.id,\n            status_symbol(&node.status),\n            title,\n            node.priority,\n            dep_type_str,\n            cycle_mark\n        );\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_dep(beads_dir: Use 'down', 'up', or 'both'\",\n                        direction\n                    ))\n                }\n            };\n\n            if format == \"json\" {\n                // JSON output                  print_dep_tree(&up_nodes, &storage)?;\n                } else {\n                    let nodes = storage.get_dep_tree(&id, direction, max_depth)?;\n
